title: Bounded uncertain-spend tolerance, unknown-charge redispatch, and a 600-second read timeout for the Phase 3 main identity

problem.as_built: The main driver constructed its accounting client with halt_on_unknown_charge=True, ran passes with fatal_unknown_charge=True, raised on any halt other than checker_malformed, could not resume an identity after failure, latched the request journal after any raised call, and required zero uncertain spend and zero unknown-charge findings at finalization.

evidence.rate: about 1.5 to 2.1 unknown charges per hour of serial execution under the frozen transport pins (read timeout 120 s)
evidence.main_scale: about 19x the canary's rows, serial, on the order of 100+ hours of provider execution and 150 to 250 expected unknown charges; expected time to identity death under the as-built policy about 30 minutes

policy_artifact.binding: pinned by raw SHA-256 in rejudge/phase3_main_runtime_policies.py and bound through the main manifest's source commit; not a manifest input binding (methods consult item 4)

ceiling.trip_disposition: identity halts fail-closed for owner review; no automatic successor

decisions.journal: the journaling wrapper releases its unresolved-dispatch marker only when the raised failure is the accounting client's UnknownChargeHalt carrying the exact attempt id and the durable unknown_charge ledger event for the same cell, role, slot, attempt, and request fingerprint, with no usage or response and no journaled success for the key; every other failure keeps the latch
decisions.redispatch: permitted for an unobserved transport failure under a new attempt id with the same request, seed, and journaled upstream history; journaled responses are never regenerated; retry rates are reported by model, role, condition, and question; results are described as applying to the declared timeout and retry procedure
decisions.pass_runner: fatal_unknown_charge=False; per-pass abandonment guard (100 absolute, or 90% of at least 10 attempted) halts the pass; the driver cools down 1,800 s and continues; 8 consecutive abandoned-rate passes halt the identity; a pass that completes nothing while abandoning cells is treated the same way
decisions.finalization: reconciliation tolerates only findings whose problem is unknown_charge; accounting allows bounded uncertain spend with completion label PASS_CONSERVATIVE_UNCERTAIN (PASS_CLEAN when zero); per-model counts and uncertain USD, and a retry report by model, role, condition, and question; prior + settled + uncertain must not exceed the stage cap; unknown charges never create terminal-cell exclusions
decisions.provider_provenance: the exact-replay reconstruction accepts earlier dispatch episodes that ended in a durable unknown_charge before the final successful episode of the same logical call; failed episodes must be exactly [unknown_charge] or [released_no_charge, unknown_charge] with no response metadata or usage, and must match the replayed request except for their own dispatch authorization timestamp

transport.change: HTTP read timeout 120 s to 600 s for every model; wall clock 1,200 s, connect, write, pool, and retry pins unchanged
transport.deviation_note: the methods consult asked for 600 s on Qwen3.8 while retaining 120 s for Llama; the accounted client constructs one transport per identity, and Llama completions of at most 512 tokens finish in seconds, so the uniform pin is applied and disclosed

decisions.authorization_window: 46 days from approval (D_max 45); expiry stops new dispatches; dispatched responses are still journaled and accounted; no automatic extension
decisions.delegated_signatures: rejudge/phase3_main_delegated_signature_provenance_2026-09-06.json carries the required disclosure for every signature made with the owner's key under his dated delegation

methods_review.verdict: NO-GO on the driver as built; conditional GO once amendments A to F with the stated changes and the final-package checks pass
required_final_checks: representative long Qwen verdict live under the 600-second read timeout
refreshed forecast that explicitly covers uncertain reservations and replacement attempts
